# Housing for Health

> > A comprehensive guide to improving health outcomes through better housing design, focusing on indigenous communities and Health Hardware principles developed by Healthabitat.

Housing for Health, pioneered by the Fred Hollows Foundation and Healthabitat, provides practical guidance on housing improvements that directly impact health, particularly in indigenous communities. The program emphasizes the Health Hardware approach, sustainable water management, and community participation to address health issues like trachoma through better living environments.
